title: 🎃 Spooky Springs 2026 Results
author: Mr_Simba
excerpt: Spooky Springs 2026 results, prize details, and a quick update on the next map.
body:
Hey, everyone! Thanks for the lively participation in Spooky Springs this year. Congrats to the winners below!

  • 🥇 1st Place: MrHollowPoint

  • 🥈 2nd Place: Frostearrific

  • 🥉 3rd Place: Shotdown01

All participants can find their prize bundles in their ender chests.

📋 Next Map Update

Apologies that we have no concrete news about next map yet. We're still hard at work on the new content. Progress is good, and we're quite far along, but not far enough that I can commit to beginning phases like Heirlooms or the Splurge yet.

Open to any feedback on you all would want to see in the interim, if anything, and any of your smaller personal desires for next map. My time is of course limited, which means doing anything like a temp map would further eat that up and delay next map a bit, but I'd love the feedback either way.

❤️
